name: Chok-chok, zuby na krjuchok
source:
The main character comes to Thailand for the winter. He has a shortage of money. In a cheap condominium on the coast, where a newly-made winterer manages to rent an apartment, he will meet strange people, from whom even the author has a chill on his skin. This is what happens if there is no money for normal housing. Yes, only not all go back, some, it happens, and put in the ground. Rumor has it that the real Thai curse is operating on the territory of the condominium, although it may be just childish tricks. Oops. It seems that I have already said more than I should have, because you can't talk about anything at all — chok-chok, teeth on a hook!

[From [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-1-0-2993]anivisual[/url]]
translation:
主角来到泰国过冬。他缺钱。在海边的一栋廉价公寓里，一个刚入冬的人租到了一套公寓，他会遇到一些陌生的人，连作者都感到毛骨悚然。如果没有钱购买正常住房，就会发生这种情况。是的，只是不是所有的都回去，有些，它发生了，然后埋在地下。有传言说，真正的泰国诅咒正在公寓的领土上运作，尽管这可能只是幼稚的把戏。哎呀。看来我已经说得太多了，因为你根本不能谈论任何事情——噎噎，牙齿挂在钩子上！
